rules.description: Points at the private research repository or one of its paths. Build work must never depend on it.
Uses a vendor trademark in code, UI text or a file name. Trademarks may appear only in docs/ and Markdown, as plain 'compatible with' statements.
Looks like a prebuilt player bundle: a minified or content-hashed script or style sheet. Course fixtures must be source we authored or open-source output; allow-list open-source output with a reason.
rules.source: Generic build-output markers, not vendor file names. specs/storyline.md section 4, 'Published web package': the player runtime ships as prebuilt bundles shared by every course. specs/rise.md section 4, 'Published web package': hashed script and style bundles.

allow.reason: Documentation may state compatibility with the vendor's products.
Markdown prose may state compatibility with the vendor's products.
Describes where the study team records findings; it links nothing a build agent could open.

allowText.reason: Spec rule tags in test titles name the spec file, for example [storyline:R5].
